Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA ZOOLOGICAL GARDEN. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to the Minnesota Zoological Garden.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA ZOOLOGICAL GARDEN.

$4,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $4,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Minnesota Zoological Board for programs at and development of the Minnesota Zoological Garden and to expand access, engage new audiences, and provide education related to the cultural heritage of Minnesota.
additions: $4,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $4,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Minnesota Zoological Board for programs at and development of the Minnesota Zoological Garden and to expand access, engage new audiences, and provide education related to the cultural heritage of Minnesota.
